title: Intelligence in the Age of AI with new CTO of the CIA

thesis: The podcast discusses the CIA's strategic pivot from a vertical, crisis-focused, internal approach to a horizontal, forward-looking, and external one, driven by the need to address technology as a central pillar of great power competition. It argues that while generative AI enables anyone to impersonate others, sophisticated fingerprinting methods make detection easier, suggesting that human-centric intelligence remains a critical advantage in this chaotic environment.
